chart_review_items.title: Add ECDF and comparable distributions
chart_review_items.current_state: Histogram and box/violin/beeswarm are present; no cumulative distribution family is registered.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Users answer threshold/percentile questions and compare groups without export.
acceptance_criteria: ECDF reports fraction of valid observations at or below a value.
Ties, invalid values, and empty selections are tested.
Count versus within-group percentage is explicit.
Baseline scope is named and persists as configured.

chart_review_items.title: Add named baseline/selection comparison
chart_review_items.current_state: Existing shared filters and saved settings provide a starting point, not a complete comparison feature.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Users compare the current population with a precisely defined reference selection.
acceptance_criteria: All data, pre-selection population, and saved predicate are different named choices.
Raw snapshot versus reevaluated predicate behavior is explicit on data changes.
Comparison marks use compatible scales and metric definitions.
Population count and valid-value denominator are available.
Cards, distributions, and references consume the same scope definition.
